moments.title: Use of force in self-protection
moments.effectiveStatement: The effective date has not been read. Do not quote a date.
moments.modelNote: Justification rules that decide when using a gun is lawful. Not the whole law of crime and defense. Text is not loaded. Do not declare a shooting justified. This note is not statute text.

moments.title: Firearm, the length test
moments.effectiveStatement: The effective date has not been read. Do not quote a date.
moments.modelNote: The definition that gates the concealed-carry offense by barrel and overall length. A rifle-sized machine gun can be an offensive weapon and still sit outside that offense. Text is not loaded. This note is not statute text.

moments.title: Offensive weapons
moments.effectiveStatement: The effective date has not been read. Do not quote a date.
moments.modelNote: Pennsylvania offensive-weapons offense. The NFA-compliance defense and the purpose-not-prohibited sentence both stay in view. The record does not pick a winner. Text is not loaded. This note is not statute text.

moments.title: Persons not to possess firearms
moments.effectiveStatement: The effective date has not been read. Do not quote a date.
moments.modelNote: The Pennsylvania statute on who may not possess, use, manufacture, control, sell, or transfer a firearm, including the court application for relief from that disability. Text and effective date are not loaded. Do not decide that a particular person has lost or regained the right. This note is not statute text.

moments.title: Restoration of firearm rights for offenses under prior laws
moments.effectiveStatement: The effective date has not been read. Do not quote a date.
moments.modelNote: The Pennsylvania proceeding to restore firearm rights for a disabling offense under prior laws. Text and effective date are not loaded. Do not decide that a particular person qualifies. This note is not statute text.

moments.title: Federal firearms disability
moments.effectiveStatement: The effective date has not been read. Do not quote a date.
moments.modelNote: A federal prohibition that can still bind a person after Pennsylvania restoration. On the loss-and-restoration walk and the preemption walk only for that reason. Text is not loaded. This note is not statute text.

moments.title: Firearms not to be carried without a license
moments.effectiveStatement: The effective date has not been read. Do not quote a date.
moments.modelNote: The concealed and vehicle carry offense. Concealment opens it only after the length test. The sportsman's permit is a separate unchecked moment. Text is not loaded. This note is not statute text.

moments.title: Sportsman's firearm permit
moments.effectiveStatement: The effective date has not been read. Do not quote a date.
moments.modelNote: The permit that ties a hunting use back to the concealed-carry offense. No Game Code citation is loaded. A rule about taking game is a different question. This note is not statute text.

moments.modelNote: State law that singles out Philadelphia or a city of the first class. A later decision may limit it. That decision is a separate moment. Text is not loaded. This note is not statute text.
